pom.xml: +    <!-- Spring Boot 4 / Spring 7: Spring Framework CVE-2026-47884 / CVE-2026-47890 are fixed only in 7.0.9. -->
-    <!-- Override Spring Boot 3.5.16's tomcat 10.1.55. 10.1.60 fixes CVE-2026-76183 /
-         Explicit dependencyManagement entries are required because this POM imports
+    <!-- Explicit dependencyManagement entries are required because this POM imports
-    <!-- lettuce-core 7.x requires Netty 4.2+; Spring Boot 3.5.16 provides 4.1.x.
-         4.2.17.Final addresses High findings still present on 4.1.118 / 4.2.16. -->
-    <!-- Container scanning (Trivy): jackson-core/databind 2.21.4 → HIGH CVEs fixed in 2.21.7.
-         Import jackson-bom ahead of spring-boot-dependencies so the whole jackson.core line moves. -->
+         Stay on the patched 4.2.x line (4.2.18.Final, aligned with the other M28 services). -->
+    <!-- Jackson 3 is the application JSON mapper. Jackson 2 still arrives transitively (swagger-core, drivers);
+         jackson-core/databind 2.21.4 has HIGH CVEs fixed in 2.21.7.
+         Import both Jackson BOMs ahead of spring-boot-dependencies so the whole Jackson 2 and 3 lines move. -->
-        jackson-bom second so it overrides Spring Boot's jackson 2.21.4 (CVE-2026-89407 / CVE-2026-89425 / CVE-2026-68497 / CVE-2026-91776 / CVE-2026-91777),
-        spring-boot-dependencies third as the parent BOM providing default dependency management,
-        spring-security-bom fourth as it may need to override Spring Framework versions for security purposes,
-        spring-framework-bom fifth as it provides core dependencies that can be safely overridden by the security BOM,
-        os-core-common last so its overrides apply on top of Spring.
